documents-label-special-categories-conte: If you want to apply in special categories (Journalist,  Ex-Serviceman/Dependent of Ex-Serviceman, State Government Employee/ MHADA FCFS Employee, Physically Handicapped, PMAY)
Generate a certificate using 'Generate Certificate' option and get it signed from concerned competent authority.
For MHADA FCFS Employee Need to upload I-card having employee number
For PH category Need to upload UDID/ Swavlamban card
If you are Artist and you do not have certificate then your category verification is subject to submission and validation of Artist certificate before possession.

If you are Freedom Fighter / Legal Heir of Freedom Fighter and you do not have certificate then your category verification is subject to submission and validation of Freedom Fighter / Legal Heir of Freedom Fighter certificate before possession.
If you are MP/MLA/MLC and you do not have certificate then your category verification is subject to submission and validation of MP/MLA/MLC certificate before possession.
